Test build.

  • Three courses: NSW Year 12 Economics, NSW Year 11 Maths, and Economics, International A Level (Edexcel). Pick one from the course button on Home.
  • The Edexcel course covers Pearson Edexcel International A Level Economics. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Pearson.
  • Maths questions are made fresh each time. Write the working with the keypad.
  • The NSW study notes are a first draft, still to be checked against the NESA syllabus.
  • Real friends need an account. Add them by username or by code. Challenges work in all three courses, races in NSW Economics and Maths. The sample friends are pretend.
  • The store shows example prices. Buying is switched off.
  • Press A to D to answer and Enter for the next slide. In Practice, H gives a clue and S skips.
  • Progress is saved on this device. With an account, which is optional, it syncs across your devices.
